title: Collaboration Workspace Access Governance Policy
content: Synthetic collaboration-platform access policy for Example Manufacturing. IT Support may view workspace membership and role-synchronization status to investigate access requests. Only an authorized Enterprise Applications administrator may change workspace membership, roles, or access privileges after validating an approved business request. This decision-support platform must not alter workspace access, team records, roles, or privileges. The policy does not define synchronization timing or authorize bypassing workspace controls. Korean reference summary: 팀 이동 후 협업 플랫폼 로그인은 되지만 새 팀 워크스페이스에 접근할 수 없는 경우, IT Support는 membership과 역할 동기화 상태만 조회할 수 있습니다. 권한 변경은 authorized Enterprise Applications administrator만 수행합니다.
